summary: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an Acquisition Agreement dated August 17, 2026, under which its Canadian subsidiary (SubCo) will amalgamate with Polymath Research Inc. under the Canada Business Corporations Act. Polymath shareholders will receive, on a pro rata basis, TruGolf Class A common stock equal to 19.9% of outstanding shares plus Series C convertible preferred stock calculated from a $140,000,000 reference amount minus the value of the common stock issued. Outstanding Polymath options will be assumed and converted into TruGolf options under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. The transaction is conditioned on TruGolf entering into a waiver and exchange agreement and completing a concurrent financing of up to $5,000,000 (with an initial tranche of $3,000,000) in Series B convertible preferred stock. No board recommendation, advisors, premium, or closing date were disclosed. Watch for requisite regulatory approvals and the closing of the concurrent financing tranche.
